PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Server rules of the Octahedron world
PluginData.Description: Server rules that only the Octahedron world uses: the economy stations' refill and refill rules for new and docked ships, refill containers, braking at the world's edge, starter ships from the stations' hologram tables, block limits for welded projections, a PCU cap per ship or station, free ship builds up to 30,000 PCU, shipyards with Build, Repair, Grind and Hack modes in their build volume, ships ordered from the shipyards, idle shipyards sweeping garbage, a real account for the stations' faction with a daily wealth tax and an hourly dividend, its prices and stock at the stations' Store blocks, contracts posted and paid by that faction, including server-wide wreck hunts, police alerts and resupply, taxi rides to a GPS point, a partitioning-friendly spawn pattern for Modular Encounters Systems, and (on hold) the NPC encounters spawned from the plugin's own blueprints.
